offlineOnly: The profiles are an offline analysis population. They are never assigned to a real player, never read save or telemetry data and never ship in the runtime (CLAUDE.md 11.5: no hidden individualized dynamic difficulty).

policy.name: HUMAN_BR
policy.perception: with probability mu a front's perceived count is raw instead of reachable
policy.choice: with probability epsilon a uniformly random legal front, else softmax over utility / tau
policy.pool: productive fronts, all fronts when none is productive
policy.latency: t0 + t1 * log2(1 + legalFronts) seconds per decision (diagnostic only)
policy.rngDrawOrder: per front: perception; then slip; then softmax
